verdict.rationale: The PlayCanvas Engine is published on GitHub as an open-source engine, and a runtime probe confirms it ships under the MIT license. Some related tooling, such as the Editor MCP server and the SuperSplat Viewer, is also open source. However, the hosted browser-based Editor, a major part of the product, has no evidence of open-source availability. Missing for 10: evidence that the PlayCanvas Editor source is available under an open license, and first-party documentation stating the license terms beyond the probe's MIT note.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
